title: "Detention exposure report"
description: "Among the trailers that DEPARTED in the window, those whose dwell exceeded `thresholdMinutes` (default 120, the two hour norm), per trailer kind. This is exposure, a proxy: no standard definition of detention exists and charging is out of scope. A dwell equal to the threshold does not exceed it. Until the analytics read side is wired the report has no rows. `from` and `to` are required RFC 3339 instants (to after from, at most 92 days). Definitions: ADR 0011."

Among the trailers that DEPARTED in the window, those whose dwell exceeded `thresholdMinutes` (default 120, the two hour norm), per trailer kind. This is exposure, a proxy: no standard definition of detention exists and charging is out of scope. A dwell equal to the threshold does not exceed it. Until the analytics read side is wired the report has no rows. `from` and `to` are required RFC 3339 instants (to after from, at most 92 days). Definitions: ADR 0011.
